      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

        lastName:

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80

          pattern: '^[0-9\s()-]*$'

## Summary

I implemented the `namesakeCount` feature so that when an owner is created, the response includes the count of other owners who already shared the same last name at that moment.

Changes:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `namesakeCount` integer property to the `Owner` schema (regenerates `OwnerDto` with the new field).

2. **`Owner.java`** — Added a `@Transient` `Integer namesakeCount` field with getter/setter. It's transient because the value is a snapshot computed at creation time, not persisted state (mirroring the intent, and avoiding a DB schema change).

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — Computes the namesake count *before* saving the new owner (so it counts only the *other*, pre-existing owners) via a new `countNamesakes(lastName)` helper that matches last names ignoring case. MapStruct maps the field into `OwnerDto` automatically by name.

4. **Tests** — Added two integration tests: one verifying a novel last name reports `0`, and one verifying two existing (case-insensitive) namesakes yield a count of `2`, excluding the new owner itself.

All existing and new tests pass.
